title: Warm Spicy French Duck Rillettes
description: A romantic French dish featuring poached duck, vanilla bean paste, and a spicy kick, served as a crispy rillette on a tagliere board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Poach the duck breast in simmering water for 10 minutes, then let it cool.
Shred the cooled duck breast into small pieces and place it in a bowl.
Add the vanilla bean paste, thyme, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Melt the unsalted butter in a skillet over medium heat and add the duck mixture.
Cook the duck mixture for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the duck mixture to a tagliere board and top it with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the rillettes warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
